title: SoundCloud Elevates Maurice Slade to Head of Music
summary: The former Epic exec takes charge of global music initiatives at the audio platform.
contentText:
Maurice Slade has been elevated to head of music at SoundCloud, an expansion of his duties after nearly four years with the company. 

Reporting directly to CEO Eliah Seton , Slade will oversee SoundCloud’s global music strategy, including artist development, cultural programming and partnerships across all-things music. His role reinforces SoundCloud’s DNA as a launchpad for early‑stage creators and strengthens its commitment to championing artists before they break. Slade said his top priority is preserving SoundCloud’s authentic, artist‑first foundation while “protecting experimentation in a world increasingly shaped by algorithms, bots, and AI.”

“Maurice has a deep understanding of artists, culture, and how careers are actually built,” said Seton. “He brings deep credibility in music, sharp strategic instincts, and a clear point of view on how platforms can serve artists without compromising creativity. As SoundCloud continues to invest in creators at the earliest stages of their journey, Maurice’s leadership will help shape how the next generation of artists are discovered, supported, and sustained.”

Slade previously served as head of marketing, artist relations, where he has, since 2022 , strengthened creator relationships and helped reinforce SoundCloud’s reputation as a creator‑centric platform.

His background includes senior marketing and strategy roles at Epic Records — where he helped lead campaigns for Travis Scott and 21 Savage — and at Roc Nation, where he worked on branding for J. Cole, Rihanna, Kanye West, and Big Sean. He also contributed to early brand-building efforts for Drake, Lil Wayne and Kid Cudi during his time at Universal Motown.

Outside the label world, Slade co‑founded the live event brands Grits & Biscuits and Dial-Up, both of which draw tens of thousands of fans annually, giving him a strong grounding in real‑world artist‑fan connection.

His appointment comes following a year of significant innovation for SoundCloud, which has introduced new social discovery tools, personalized recommendations, expanded creator subscriptions and partnerships with TikTok, Ticketmaster/Universe and elasticStage, while also growing into new markets such as Mexico.
